description: Rb₂NaMn₃F₁₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Rb-F bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.06 Å. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Rb-F bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.21 Å. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.86 Å. There are five inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-45°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.82-2.12 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-43°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.09 Å. In the third Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-43°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.13 Å. In the fourth Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-45°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.14 Å. In the fifth Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-43°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.07 Å. There are twelve inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and one Mn atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and one Mn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Mn atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Mn atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Rb, one Na, and one Mn atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Rb, one Na, and one Mn atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb and two Mn atoms. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two Mn atoms. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Rb and two Mn atoms. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb and two Mn atoms.
